intro.text: A maid in Meridas Amaram's household in the Sadeas warcamp.

items.text: Shallan needed to get into Amaram's manor and chose to pose as Telesh, who looked like her and often went out. She had secretly sketched her, and after Telesh left one night Shallan took on her appearance with Lightweaving.
As "Telesh", Shallan ran into Amaram, who told her to settle down instead of dating two men and spoke warmly of her father, surprising Shallan with how well he knew a lowly maid.

appearance.text: Young and darkeyed, around five foot six and slender, with hair to the middle of her back and a high-pitched voice.

personality.text: Chipper and giggly. She takes her job lightly and slips out often, protected by Amaram's favour, and goes out every night, dating several men at once.
